binding.project_revision: sha256 digest of the exact project revision
binding.worktree_digest: sha256 digest of the supplied worktree binding

lifecycle.recovery: an interrupted or failed session is not resumed by this boundary; a future AR must obtain a new Coordinator admission, owner, session, and lease

gates.network: disabled in offline mode; explicit bounded gate required for live integration
gates.human_approval: not silently inferred; UI authority owns validated approval

privacy.projection: opaque identifiers, bounded enums, integer observations, and sha256 digests only

failure_semantics.external_effects: none in this specification: no Coordinator, network, provider, LLM, process, Git, or durable-state operation

limitations: The harness validates supplied observations and does not prove physical worktree isolation or a live lease.
Offline qualification is not provider, network, hosted-CI, remote, or Coordinator success.
Live transport, crash injection, and human approval remain separately gated integration work.
